owner_authorization_verbatim: Initialize another round of research , given quota of 96 hours and unlimited token quota
owner_parallel_instruction_verbatim: launch 3 parallel subagents to investigate per area (info , math , physics)
interpretation: Three research subagents total: one information-science, one mathematics, one physics. Each investigates, selects and attacks precise unresolved targets in its domain; the parent integrates and verifies.
clock_basis: First observed local clock during initialization; the 96-hour wall-clock authorization includes selection, research, verification and reporting.
token_scope: No user-imposed token ceiling. Actual provider availability, subscription limits and context limits remain real; no paid API fallback, account rotation, model/config changes or quota bypass is authorized.
orchestration: Three ordinary in-harness subagents under this parent session. This record is not a daemon, scheduler or promise of unattended execution after the session stops. No cron, launchd, old engine restart or automatic modification of historical records.

baseline.rule: Historical accepted claims, candidates, UNKNOWN results, rejected evidence, process deviations and unperformed reviews keep their exact status. The new three-agent instruction replaces the old round's concurrency count for this round only; it does not clear old correctness or runtime safety holds. Earlier findings are baselines, not new discoveries.

lanes.initial_assignment: Compare precise open information-science targets against current primary sources and local completed work, freeze the most consequential tractable claim, and begin a substantive attack. Do not automatically repeat PA19, CFR21 or six-MOLS39 searches.

Compare precise open mathematics targets against current primary sources, the openai/math corpus and local completed work, freeze a claim with real headroom, and begin a substantive attack. Olson/Shor are optional continuations, not default obligations; repeating the covered insertion family or old Shor restriction is not progress.

Compare precise open physics targets with current primary sources and local completed work, freeze a theoretical claim with checkable consequences, and begin a substantive attack. Do not automatically repeat MOQLS8, RQLS10 or already-classified small-code ansatz searches.

selection_gate.compare: At least three exact candidate statements per domain, including a genuinely fresh candidate relative to the immediately preceding round. Prefer fresh targets when an old route lacks a materially new ingredient.
freeze_before_attack: Exact book question and page provenance, or explicit relationship of a modern precise target to that question
Strongest comparable baseline and accessible primary-source statement; source-access limitations
Current status: a dated source declaring openness, or uncertified-open rather than an inference from search misses
Exact desired theorem, construction, counterexample or bound, including all quantifiers
Missing ingredient, first bounded attack, independent verification route and concrete redirect condition
selection_gate.anti_repetition: A rephrased known necessary condition, another finite range without a consequential claim, or another failed search is not a scientific advance. Preserve negative evidence; redirect with a new frozen statement instead of silently weakening the goal.

initial_execution.allowed: Source reading, mathematical reasoning, source/page extraction and metadata checks within the lane. No substantial native scientific computation is admitted by initialization alone.
initial_execution.compute_admission: Before a new scientific program, solver, compilation, large enumeration or load-bearing certificate replay: send the exact command, source/input hashes, consequence, positive/negative controls, CPU/RAM/output estimates, deadline and graceful settlement plan to the parent. Parent must check fresh resources and old holds and record a named GO. This is not an instruction to repair or restart the previous runtime framework.
initial_execution.conservative_resource_ceiling_after_admi: At most four CPU threads, 8 GiB RAM and 2 GiB new output per domain; no GPU or remote compute. Aggregate at most twelve scientific CPU threads and 24 GiB. Existing environments read-only; lane-local caches; single-thread BLAS unless explicitly admitted.
initial_execution.preservation: Write only new files inside the assigned lane root. Preserve earlier evidence unchanged. Corrections to frozen claims use numbered successors or addenda. No temporary-directory auto-deletion or removal of failed attempts. Parent alone owns the shared new run directory and index updates.

milestones.startup: Send the parent a real ACK after reading this contract, stating owned path and first source/target. Write startup-v1.json before substantial work.
milestones.selection: Deliver selection-v1.md with the candidate comparison and one frozen primary target; then continue the actual attack, not merely a plan.
milestones.active_checkpoint: At most 30 minutes between substantive checkpoints while active: actual finding, evidence path, exact blocker and next bounded action. Observe the clock before stamping; do not fabricate continuous work or fill missed checkpoints retroactively.
milestones.handoff: At each bounded result, provide full proof/witness or exact obstruction, novelty boundary and replay procedure. Pause for verification or redirection if it changes the target. A source/review gate can block promotion without exhausting unrelated discovery.

verification.required_for_scientific_claim: Complete proof or checkable witness; parent verification; an independent in-harness check or independently reconstructed certificate as appropriate; matched primary prior-art comparison. No build/lint/test/formatter suites mid-flight; consolidated verification after a candidate is complete, with narrowly admitted scientific experiments handled separately.
verification.external_review: Not launched: independent-model CLI use remains opt-in under current workspace policy. An old gate requiring a specific family remains unmet. In-harness checking is never described as a cross-vendor, human or formal proof gate.
verification.no_inflation: Keep correctness, formal coverage, novelty, full-book scope and publication readiness separate. UNKNOWN is not UNSAT. A source statement import is not proof authentication.

completion: Initialization is complete only after all three agents are actually launched and their startup is observed. Scientific completion is separate: defend the claimed delta, retain unresolved targets and verification gates, and report actual activity rather than elapsed authorization.
